title: Meta Gets Street-High PT, Salesforce Double Upgraded by
summary: Wall Street analysts issue major AI-focused upgrades for Meta and Salesforce. Meta receives street-high price target while Salesforce gets double upgrade.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Meta Platforms receives street-high price target from analysts citing AI infrastructure investments and ad platform improvements driving revenue growth.
- Salesforce gets rare double upgrade as analysts recognize accelerating AI agent adoption in enterprise CRM and improved margin expansion trajectory.
- Three additional AI-focused companies receive analyst upgrades, reflecting broader Wall Street optimism about commercialization of generative AI technologies in 2026.


Wall Street analysts issued five major rating changes for AI-focused technology companies on October 18, 2026, with Meta Platforms receiving a street-high price target and Salesforce earning a rare double upgrade. The coordinated analyst actions reflect growing confidence in AI monetization strategies and enterprise adoption accelerating faster than previously forecast.


## Meta Platforms Receives Street-High Price Target


Meta Platforms secured the highest price target on Wall Street as analysts cite the company's AI infrastructure investments and improved advertising platform performance. The upgraded forecast recognizes Meta's generative AI integration across Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp, which has driven measurable improvements in ad targeting accuracy and user engagement metrics. Analysts point to the company's proprietary large language models powering business messaging tools and creator monetization features as key revenue drivers through late 2026.


The street-high target reflects confidence in Meta's ability to leverage its 3 billion daily active users as training data for increasingly sophisticated recommendation systems. Analysts specifically highlighted the company's AI-powered Reels distribution algorithm, which has increased advertiser ROI by double digits quarter-over-quarter throughout 2026.


## Salesforce Earns Rare Double Upgrade


Salesforce received a double upgrade from analysts who previously maintained cautious ratings on the enterprise CRM leader. The dramatic shift follows accelerating adoption of Salesforce's AI agent platform, which has exceeded internal deployment targets across Fortune 500 customers. Analysts note that Salesforce's Einstein GPT and Agentforce products are generating measurable productivity gains, with enterprise customers reporting 30-40% reductions in customer service response times.


The double upgrade also recognizes improving margin expansion as Salesforce transitions from traditional software licensing to higher-margin AI agent subscriptions. Analysts project the company's AI-native revenue stream will represent 25% of total revenue by the end of fiscal 2027, significantly ahead of prior estimates.


## Release Date and Market Context


Officially released on October 18, 2026, these analyst upgrades arrive as Q3 2026 earnings season approaches. The timing suggests analysts are positioning ahead of expected strong AI-related revenue reports from major technology companies. Wall Street's increasing conviction in AI monetization marks a shift from earlier 2026 skepticism about generative AI's near-term profitability.


## Three Additional AI-Focused Upgrades


Beyond Meta and Salesforce, three other companies received analyst upgrades tied to AI capabilities, though specific company names were not detailed in the initial report. The coordinated analyst actions suggest a broader re-rating of AI-exposed equities as commercial applications demonstrate clear return on investment. Analysts are particularly focused on companies showing concrete AI revenue attribution rather than speculative positioning.


- Enterprise software companies with embedded AI agents are receiving premium valuations
- Cloud infrastructure providers supporting AI workloads are seeing raised estimates
- Companies demonstrating AI-driven margin improvement are attracting institutional buyers


## What This Means


The wave of analyst upgrades signals Wall Street's recognition that AI commercialization has reached an inflection point in 2026. Meta's street-high price target and Salesforce's double upgrade demonstrate that companies successfully integrating AI into core products are commanding significant valuation premiums. For investors, these analyst moves suggest the market is shifting from AI infrastructure plays to companies proving AI-driven revenue growth and margin expansion. The coordinated timing indicates analysts expect strong AI-related guidance during upcoming earnings calls, potentially establishing new valuation benchmarks for the sector heading into 2027.
